_meta.description: Real cohort vs its synthetic twin in ONE request: a union reads customers.pulse (label source) and customers_twin.pulse (label twin, written by synth from-profile --synthetic-only) as one record stream, each row tagged in the virtual _source field. Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov on income and a chi-square of region by _source ask whether the twin reproduces the source's distributions; group by _source for side-by-side figures. A tagged synth output (one cohort with a _synthetic field) answers the same question with no union.
_meta.name: union_source_vs_twin
